Yogi Adityanath warns 'anti-national' forces, discusses temple plans

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath issued a warning on Friday that "anti-national and anti-social forces" seeking to spread hatred or undermine India's unity would face consequences. He invoked Lord Krishna's message on the occasion of Janmashtami to support his statement. Adityanath also announced plans for grand temple complexes in Mathura-Vrindavan, drawing parallels to the temple complexes in Ayodhya and Kashi. He stated that invaders could destroy temples but not faith, and that those who attempted to 'eradicate' Sanatan Dharma were themselves 'wiped out'.
